title: matching keyboard and type
rule: Show the keyboard and input type that match the content (email, tel, URL, number, and equivalent platform keyboards).

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Designing Mobile Input Fields; Apple HIG — Text fields; Vercel Web Interface Guidelines

fail_when: Those contents use a generic text keyboard.
overview: Show the keyboard and input type that match email, tel, URL, or number content.
apply_when: Mobile or soft-keyboard entry for email, phone, URL, or numeric values.
not_when: Desktop hard-keyboard contexts with no soft keyboard to swap.
agent_hint: Set type/inputmode so email, tel, URL, and number get matching keyboards.
description: Show the keyboard and input type that match the content — email, tel, URL, number, and equivalent platform keyboards. Pass when those contents use matching `type`/`inputmode`/platform keyboard; fail when they use a generic text keyboard. Matching keyboards reduce typos and wrong character sets on soft-keyboard devices without changing the underlying field purpose or inventing new content types.
